plain_policy: Show this room as a guest bedroom in Angela's style, and make the open question explicit: do Daniel's desk and the smart gym stay? Each family below is laid out and ranked on its own, and the page shows the best of each side by side. Nothing may collide or stop a door; the walk from the hall door to the bathroom door, the closet and the bed must stay at least 20 inches; a bed for two needs at least 15 inches on both sides; whoever sleeps here must be able to reach and open the sliding glass door. Everything else is a trade-off. Priorities in order: the walks, bed-side room, what the room still does every day (desk, gym), storage for guests, fewest new pieces, cost.
